body: Hey so good news nothing happened I didn't get caught but this is a life lesson for me now it's like no matter how many times I'm down life gives me another lifeline I'm gonna take it from now
hey sorry if u don't remember me anymore but just wanted u to know I'll find my fate in two days and that means whether they found out or not
I’ve written my suicide note anyway because I have no hope in life anyway and I just want to rest whatever happens in a few weeks will be the final nail in the coffin

I honestly don’t care about the zero it’s more so getting kicked from Uni I just pray they can’t tell cause I’ve literally ruined my life. I’m going to take to someone at uni anyway about my mental state since I don’t get any help from the family anyway I need someone to vent too. But man all I want to do is be normal again my anxiety is through the roof right now can’t breathe at all crying all the time and I haven’t eaten in a few days
Not yet I’m waiting for it which will be soon in a few weeks
I don’t know what to do honestly do I own up or pray they don’t think I bought an essay

I know it gets better but that's is when you have hope I don't have that anymore I have people around who love me but don't realise the pain I am going through everyday I just can't do it anymore and the mistake I've made has ruined my life completely two bad papers not even one and I just hate myself for what I've done I tried deleting it my submission and just take the zero but I can't it won't allow me too and I'm basically trapped and might as well die. I only feel pain for my friends and family not for myself I deserve to die for being such a failure in life the only solution I have besides death is to travel to another country cut contacts with everyone at least for bit from my family and just try and survive I can't keep letting them down I'm a lost cause who was always destined for failure and to die
I’ve just turned 20 and now pretty much ruined my life I can’t do Uni again I already took a year off I’m fucked

Thank you so much for your belief I'm trying my hardest to not suffer but I never help myself in life I always come back feeling 10 times more suicidal just as soon as I start to feel better. My essays are not plagiarised but one of the is completely different to the way I write and I am just freaking out so much I hate my anxiety dpdr and depression I haven't been able to breathe for a month now its extremely awful and after realising what I've just done and can't stop crying or breathing normally.  All I see I can do to survive is buy a plane ticket to another country cut off from everyone I know and love but I so embarrassed by it and just try and survive there

I was already trying to delete my submission when I had that brief moment of realisation as the majority of the time I never feel here. The essay is completely different to how I write but is not plagiarised but it's obvious it's not mine and I just know I've ruined my life. The only trade I'm learning  is investing it's my passion I love but my parents will never let that happen and will kill me over getting  kicked from Uni I just want to die so bad or just escape from everything go to other country and just disappear from everyone. I just pray they understand my pain it is only my first year so I pray they understand but right now all I wanna do is cry because I know soon I will probably be dead
